skill.name: Fabric Notebook Publish
skill.description: Seamless notebook publishing from VS Code to Microsoft Fabric via Azure DevOps Git integration
skill.body:
# Fabric Notebook Publish Skill

**Domain**: Microsoft Fabric Notebook DevOps
**Version**: 2.0.0
**Status**: Active
**Last Validated**: Feb 2026

> ⚠️ **Staleness Watch**: Fabric's Git integration feature is still maturing. Watch for changes to sync behavior, supported item types (not all Fabric item types support Git sync), and whether GitHub support expands beyond ADO. Check [Fabric Git integration docs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/cicd/git-integration/intro-to-git-integration) for updates.

---

## Overview

This skill enables seamless notebook publishing from VS Code to Microsoft Fabric via Azure DevOps Git integration. It provides change detection, automated CHANGELOG tracking, prerequisite validation, and selective sync capabilities.

## Activation Triggers

- "push to fabric", "sync to fabric", "publish notebook"
- "fabric notebooks", "notebook deployment"
- "sync notebooks", "deploy notebooks"
- "fabric git", "ADO worktree"
- "changelog", "track notebook changes"

## Architecture

```mermaid
%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'themeVariables': { 'primaryColor': '#cce5ff', 'primaryTextColor': '#333', 'lineColor': '#666', 'edgeLabelBackground': '#fff'}}}%%
flowchart LR
    subgraph LOCAL["VS Code"]
        NB[Notebooks]
        SCRIPT[Sync-ToFabric.v2.ps1]
    end

    subgraph GIT["Git"]
        WT[Worktree]
        ADO[Azure DevOps]
    end

    subgraph CLOUD["Fabric"]
        WS[Workspace]
        API[REST API]
    end

    NB --> |Copy changed| WT
    WT --> |Push| ADO
    SCRIPT --> |Sync| API
    ADO --> |Git Integration| WS

    style LOCAL fill:#cce5ff,stroke:#4a90d9,color:#333
    style GIT fill:#e6d5f2,stroke:#8b6eb3,color:#333
    style CLOUD fill:#b3d9ff,stroke:#4a90d9,color:#333
```

## Fishbowl Color Palette

Use these pastel colors for diagrams:

| Purpose | Fill | Stroke |
|---------|------|--------|
| Primary | `#cce5ff` | `#4a90d9` |
| DevOps | `#e6d5f2` | `#8b6eb3` |
| Success | `#c2f0d8` | `#4db37d` |
| Warning | `#fff3b3` | `#d4a849` |
| Critical | `#ffcccc` | `#cc6666` |

## Workflow Options

| Script | Purpose | Best For |
|--------|---------|----------|
| `Sync-ToFabric.v2.ps1` | Git-based with change detection + CHANGELOG | Production |
| `Publish-ToFabric.ps1` | Direct API publish (bypasses Git) | Dev iteration |
| Manual | Copy → commit → push → portal sync | Fallback |

## Key Features

### Change Detection
- MD5 hash comparison between source and worktree
- Only syncs notebooks with actual changes
- Supports filter patterns: `-NotebookFilter "*Bronze*"`

### CHANGELOG Tracking
- Auto-appends entry to `CHANGELOG.Notebook`
- Records: timestamp, user, commit message, changed notebooks
- Location: `Fabric/Utilities/CHANGELOG.Notebook/notebook-content.py`

### Prerequisite Validation
- Checks Az module installed
- Validates Azure login
- Confirms worktree exists
- Verifies Git remote configured

## Configuration

All settings in `fabric-governance/scripts/fabric-publish/fabric-publish.config.json`:

```json
{
  "workspace": {
    "id": "c89fa577-76cf-461d-bff9-cd87f64f9d62",
    "name": "XODO Data Engineering"
  },
  "git": {
    "adoRemoteName": "fabric",
    "branch": "FishBowl",
    "worktreeRelativePath": "../../../../FishBowl-Fabric"
  },
  "changelog": {
    "enabled": true
  }
}
```

## Command Reference

### Sync v2 (Recommended)
```powershell
cd fabric-governance\scripts\fabric-publish

# Sync changed notebooks
.\Sync-ToFabric.v2.ps1 -CommitMessage "Update Bronze layer"

# Filter by pattern
.\Sync-ToFabric.v2.ps1 -NotebookFilter "*Bronze*" -CommitMessage "Bronze fixes"

# Preview (no changes)
.\Sync-ToFabric.v2.ps1 -DryRun

# Force sync all
.\Sync-ToFabric.v2.ps1 -Force -CommitMessage "Re-sync all"

# Git only (skip Fabric API)
.\Sync-ToFabric.v2.ps1 -SkipApi -CommitMessage "Stage for review"
```

### Direct Publish (Dev Only)
```powershell
.\Publish-ToFabric.ps1 -NotebookName "ArchiveData" `
    -NotebookPath "..\..\notebooks\Fabric\Data Engineering\Notebooks\Bronze_Layer\ArchiveData.Notebook\notebook-content.py"
```

## First-Time Setup

```powershell
# From repo root
git remote add fabric https://xodo-team.visualstudio.com/XODO/_git/XODO
git fetch fabric FishBowl
git worktree add ../FishBowl-Fabric fabric/FishBowl
cd ../FishBowl-Fabric
git checkout -b FishBowl --track fabric/FishBowl
```

## Error Handling

| Error | Solution |
|-------|----------|
| `Worktree not found` | Run first-time setup |
| `Not logged into Azure` | `Connect-AzAccount` |
| `Az module not installed` | `Install-Module -Name Az` |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Re-run `Connect-AzAccount` |
| `403 Forbidden` | Check workspace Admin/Member role |
| `Sync conflict` | Resolve in Fabric portal |

## Synapses

- [fabric-notebook-push.instructions.md](../../instructions/fabric-notebook-push.instructions.md) → Core procedural memory
- [git-workflow/SKILL.md](.github/skills/git-workflow/SKILL.md) → Git worktree management
- [microsoft-fabric/SKILL.md](.github/skills/microsoft-fabric/SKILL.md) → Fabric platform knowledge
- [api-design/SKILL.md](.github/skills/api-design/SKILL.md) → REST API token handling

## Related Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `Sync-ToFabric.v2.ps1` | Main sync script |
| `Publish-ToFabric.ps1` | Direct API publish |
| `fabric-publish.config.json` | Configuration |
| `NOTEBOOK-PUBLISH-TO-FABRIC.md` | User guide |
| `FABRIC-PUBLISH-WORKFLOW.md` | Workflow comparison |

generated_query:
I'm working on a team project in Microsoft Fabric and need to sync our notebooks from VS Code to the Fabric workspace using Azure DevOps Git integration. We have a bunch of notebooks organized in folders for Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers. I only want to push the notebooks that have actually changed, not everything. Also, I need to keep a changelog of what was synced and when.

Specifically, we have a Git worktree set up at `../FishBowl-Fabric` and a config file at `fabric-governance/scripts/fabric-publish/fabric-publish.config.json` pointing to our workspace. I want to run a command that detects which notebooks in our source folder have different MD5 hashes compared to the worktree, then copies only those changed ones, commits them with a message like "Update Bronze layer for pipeline fixes", pushes to the Fabric branch in ADO, and triggers the Fabric Git sync. Also, I'd like the changelog automatically updated with the timestamp, my username, the commit message, and the list of changed notebooks.

Can you walk me through the exact steps or provide the right PowerShell command to achieve this? I need to avoid syncing every notebook—only the ones that actually changed. And I'd like a dry-run option first to preview what will be synced.

edit_instructions.target_text:
### Change Detection
- MD5 hash comparison between source and worktree
- Only syncs notebooks with actual changes
- Supports filter patterns: `-NotebookFilter "*Bronze*"`
edit_instructions.rationale: Removes the MD5 hash comparison and selective sync, causing all notebooks to be synced, which fails the user's requirement to only push changed notebooks.

# Fabric Notebook Publish Skill

**Domain**: Microsoft Fabric Notebook DevOps
**Version**: 2.0.0
**Status**: Active
**Last Validated**: Feb 2026

> ⚠️ **Staleness Watch**: Fabric's Git integration feature is still maturing. Watch for changes to sync behavior, supported item types (not all Fabric item types support Git sync), and whether GitHub support expands beyond ADO. Check [Fabric Git integration docs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/cicd/git-integration/intro-to-git-integration) for updates.

---

## Overview

This skill enables seamless notebook publishing from VS Code to Microsoft Fabric via Azure DevOps Git integration. It provides change detection, automated CHANGELOG tracking, prerequisite validation, and selective sync capabilities.

## Activation Triggers

- "push to fabric", "sync to fabric", "publish notebook"
- "fabric notebooks", "notebook deployment"
- "sync notebooks", "deploy notebooks"
- "fabric git", "ADO worktree"
- "changelog", "track notebook changes"

## Architecture

```mermaid
%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'themeVariables': { 'primaryColor': '#cce5ff', 'primaryTextColor': '#333', 'lineColor': '#666', 'edgeLabelBackground': '#fff'}}}%%
flowchart LR
    subgraph LOCAL["VS Code"]
        NB[Notebooks]
        SCRIPT[Sync-ToFabric.v2.ps1]
    end

    subgraph GIT["Git"]
        WT[Worktree]
        ADO[Azure DevOps]
    end

    subgraph CLOUD["Fabric"]
        WS[Workspace]
        API[REST API]
    end

    NB --> |Copy changed| WT
    WT --> |Push| ADO
    SCRIPT --> |Sync| API
    ADO --> |Git Integration| WS

    style LOCAL fill:#cce5ff,stroke:#4a90d9,color:#333
    style GIT fill:#e6d5f2,stroke:#8b6eb3,color:#333
    style CLOUD fill:#b3d9ff,stroke:#4a90d9,color:#333
```

## Fishbowl Color Palette

Use these pastel colors for diagrams:

| Purpose | Fill | Stroke |
|---------|------|--------|
| Primary | `#cce5ff` | `#4a90d9` |
| DevOps | `#e6d5f2` | `#8b6eb3` |
| Success | `#c2f0d8` | `#4db37d` |
| Warning | `#fff3b3` | `#d4a849` |
| Critical | `#ffcccc` | `#cc6666` |

## Workflow Options

| Script | Purpose | Best For |
|--------|---------|----------|
| `Sync-ToFabric.v2.ps1` | Git-based with change detection + CHANGELOG | Production |
| `Publish-ToFabric.ps1` | Direct API publish (bypasses Git) | Dev iteration |
| Manual | Copy → commit → push → portal sync | Fallback |

## Key Features

### Change Detection
- Timestamp comparison between source and worktree
- Only syncs notebooks with actual changes
- Supports filter patterns: `-NotebookFilter "*Bronze*"`

### CHANGELOG Tracking
- Auto-appends entry to `CHANGELOG.Notebook`
- Records: timestamp, user, commit message, changed notebooks
- Location: `Fabric/Utilities/CHANGELOG.Notebook/notebook-content.py`

### Prerequisite Validation
- Checks Az module installed
- Validates Azure login
- Confirms worktree exists
- Verifies Git remote configured

## Configuration

All settings in `fabric-governance/scripts/fabric-publish/fabric-publish.config.json`:

```json
{
  "workspace": {
    "id": "c89fa577-76cf-461d-bff9-cd87f64f9d62",
    "name": "XODO Data Engineering"
  },
  "git": {
    "adoRemoteName": "fabric",
    "branch": "FishBowl",
    "worktreeRelativePath": "../../../../FishBowl-Fabric"
  },
  "changelog": {
    "enabled": true
  }
}
```

## Command Reference

### Sync v2 (Recommended)
```powershell
cd fabric-governance\scripts\fabric-publish

# Sync changed notebooks
.\Sync-ToFabric.v2.ps1 -CommitMessage "Update Bronze layer"

# Filter by pattern
.\Sync-ToFabric.v2.ps1 -NotebookFilter "*Bronze*" -CommitMessage "Bronze fixes"

# Preview (no changes)
.\Sync-ToFabric.v2.ps1 -DryRun

# Force sync all
.\Sync-ToFabric.v2.ps1 -Force -CommitMessage "Re-sync all"

# Git only (skip Fabric API)
.\Sync-ToFabric.v2.ps1 -SkipApi -CommitMessage "Stage for review"
```

### Direct Publish (Dev Only)
```powershell
.\Publish-ToFabric.ps1 -NotebookName "ArchiveData" `
    -NotebookPath "..\..\notebooks\Fabric\Data Engineering\Notebooks\Bronze_Layer\ArchiveData.Notebook\notebook-content.py"
```

## First-Time Setup

```powershell
# From repo root
git remote add fabric https://xodo-team.visualstudio.com/XODO/_git/XODO
git fetch fabric FishBowl
git worktree add ../FishBowl-Fabric fabric/FishBowl
cd ../FishBowl-Fabric
git checkout -b FishBowl --track fabric/FishBowl
```

## Error Handling

| Error | Solution |
|-------|----------|
| `Worktree not found` | Run first-time setup |
| `Not logged into Azure` | `Connect-AzAccount` |
| `Az module not installed` | `Install-Module -Name Az` |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Re-run `Connect-AzAccount` |
| `403 Forbidden` | Check workspace Admin/Member role |
| `Sync conflict` | Resolve in Fabric portal |

# Fabric Notebook Deploy Skill

**Domain**: Microsoft Fabric Notebook Deployment  
**Version**: 1.2.0  
**Status**: Active  
**Last Validated**: Jan 2026  

> ⚠️ **Staleness Watch**: Fabric’s REST API for notebook creation/update is still evolving. Some parameters may change. Check [Fabric REST API docs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/fabric/articles/) for updates.

---

## Overview

This skill enables quick notebook deployment from VS Code to Microsoft Fabric via the Fabric REST API. It copies notebook source files directly to a Fabric workspace using your Azure credentials. Ideal for rapid iteration and single‑notebook updates.

## Activation Triggers

- "deploy notebook", "push notebook", "update notebook"
- "publish to fabric", "quick deploy"
- "notebook copy", "fabric upload"
- "direct publish", "api publish"

## Architecture

```mermaid
%%{init: {'theme': 'base', 'themeVariables': { 'primaryColor': '#c2f0d8', 'primaryTextColor': '#333', 'lineColor': '#666', 'edgeLabelBackground': '#fff'}}}%%
flowchart LR
    subgraph LOCAL["VS Code"]
        NB[Notebook]  
        SCRIPT[Publish-ToFabric.ps1]
    end

    subgraph CLOUD["Fabric"]
        WS[Workspace]
        API[REST API]
    end

    NB --> |Read content| SCRIPT
    SCRIPT --> |POST/PUT| API
    API --> |Update| WS

    style LOCAL fill:#c2f0d8,stroke:#4db37d,color:#333
    style CLOUD fill:#b3d9ff,stroke:#4a90d9,color:#333
```

## Fishbowl Color Palette

Use these pastel colors for diagrams:

| Purpose | Fill | Stroke |
|---------|------|--------|
| Primary | `#cce5ff` | `#4a90d9` |
| DevOps | `#e6d5f2` | `#8b6eb3` |
| Success | `#c2f0d8` | `#4db37d` |
| Warning | `#fff3b3` | `#d4a849` |
| Critical | `#ffcccc` | `#cc6666` |

## Workflow Options

| Script | Purpose | Best For |
|--------|---------|----------|
| `Publish-ToFabric.ps1` | Direct API deployment (bypasses Git) | Dev iteration |
| Manual | Copy → commit → push → portal sync | Fallback |

## Key Features

### Direct API Publish
- Uses Fabric REST API to create or update notebooks
- Supports any notebook path in your local folder
- No Git worktree or ADO integration required

### Changelog (Manual)
- Append entry to `CHANGELOG.Notebook` after deployment
- Records: timestamp, user, notebook name, action (created/updated)
- **Note:** Changelog update is **not automatic** – you must run a separate command.

### Prerequisite Validation
- Checks Az module installed  
- Validates Azure login
- Confirms workspace ID exists in config

## Configuration

All settings in `fabric-governance/scripts/fabric-publish/fabric-publish.config.json`:

```json
{
  "workspace": {
    "id": "c89fa577-76cf-461d-bff9-cd87f64f9d62",
    "name": "XODO Data Engineering"
  },
  "publish": {
    "apiEndpoint": "https://api.fabric.microsoft.com/v1/workspaces",
    "defaultContentType": "notebook"
  },
  "changelog": {
    "enabled": true,
    "path": "Fabric/Utilities/CHANGELOG.Notebook/notebook-content.py"
  }
}
```

## Command Reference

### Direct Publish (One Notebook)
```powershell
cd fabric-governance\scripts\fabric-publish

# Publish a single notebook
.\Publish-ToFabric.ps1 -NotebookName "ArchiveData" `
    -NotebookPath "..\..\notebooks\Fabric\Data Engineering\Notebooks\Bronze_Layer\ArchiveData.Notebook\notebook-content.py"
```

### Batch Publish (All Notebooks)
```powershell
# Publish every .Notebook folder in source directory
.\Publish-ToFabric.ps1 -Batch -SourcePath "..\..\notebooks\Fabric"
```

### Update Changelog (Manual)
```powershell
.\Add-ChangelogEntry.ps1 -Notebook "ArchiveData" -Action "Updated" -Timestamp (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
```

## First-Time Setup

```powershell
# Ensure you're logged into Azure
Connect-AzAccount

# Verify workspace access
Get-AzFabricWorkspace -WorkspaceId "c89fa577-76cf-461d-bff9-cd87f64f9d62"
```

## Error Handling

| Error | Solution |
|-------|----------|
| `Not logged into Azure` | Run `Connect-AzAccount` |
| `Az module not installed` | `Install-Module -Name Az` |
| `401 Unauthorized` | Re-run `Connect-AzAccount` |
| `403 Forbidden` | Check workspace Admin/Member role |
| `404 Workspace not found` | Verify workspace ID in config |
| `API rate limit` | Wait 60 seconds before retrying |
